items.title: Donn Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 6, 2009
items.q: So I called her and I said, “I’m in a college jazz band and we’re going on the Holland America Lines and we’re going to be in Rotterdam on such and such a —.” “Oh you must come and play in my club.” So we did that.

ctx.x: Well is there anything that you make sure that you wanted to clear up about the history of the Alumni Jazz Band?

Well I think that probably the highlight of our career were the two things that we did in 1956 and that was the trip to Europe and all things associated with that and then the Carnegie Hall concert. And how those two things happened I explained about the Carnegie Hall thing. The boat trip to Europe, back in those years, ’55 may have been the first year, the Holland America line was running student sailings. They had 800 students crammed on an old liberty ship. And the Tigertown Five from Princeton played the year…
You did three clubs in a row?
